features.heading: Your site, talking cleanly to the tools behind it

items.title: Connected to what you actually use
items.description: We wire your website into booking calendars, payment gateways, CRMs, maps, email, and WhatsApp, so every enquiry, order, and booking lands in the right place automatically — no manual re-entry.

items.title: Built to survive real-world APIs
items.description: Each integration gets retries, timeouts, clear error handling, and a fallback, so a slow or down third-party service never breaks your page or silently loses a customer's submission.

items.title: Your own accounts and credentials
items.description: We connect through your accounts and API keys, document each one, and hand them over in full — nothing is tied to us, and you can rotate, revoke, or move any connection whenever you want.

items.title: Fast pages, even with live data
items.description: We call external services server-side and cache responses sensibly, so pulling live availability, prices, or listings never drags down load times or exposes your keys to the browser.

faqs.question: Which third-party services can you connect my website to?
faqs.answer: Common ones include Stripe and local payment gateways, booking and scheduling tools like Calendly, CRMs such as HubSpot or Zoho, Google Maps and Places, Mailchimp and similar email platforms, and WhatsApp. If a service offers an API or webhook, we can almost always connect it — tell us your tools in the free consultation and we'll confirm what's possible.

faqs.question: What happens if one of the connected services goes down or changes its API?
faqs.answer: We build every integration to fail gracefully, so a third-party outage shows a friendly message or falls back rather than breaking your site or losing a customer's form. We also keep the integration code clean and documented, so when a provider updates its API it's a quick, contained fix rather than a rebuild.

faqs.question: Do I need to share my passwords or accounts with you?
faqs.answer: No passwords. Integrations run on API keys and secure tokens generated inside your own accounts, which keeps you in full control. We set them up with you, store them safely server-side, and document each one so your team can rotate or revoke access at any time. You own every credential when we hand over.

faqs.question: Will adding these integrations slow my website down?
faqs.answer: It shouldn't. We make external calls on the server and cache results where it's sensible, so live data like availability or pricing loads fast and your API keys never reach the browser. Keeping the site quick and secure is part of how we build the integration, not an afterthought.

faqs.question: Can I see it working before I commit?
faqs.answer: Yes. We start with a free consultation to map out exactly which tools you want connected and how the data should flow, then show you a working preview of the integration before you commit to anything. Everything is delivered in both Arabic and English, and the easiest way to start is a quick message on WhatsApp.
